rawText: DEMO FIXTURE — not a live tender. Managed IT helpdesk and endpoint support for Uttar Pradesh. The bidder shall have average annual turnover of at least Rs. 15 lakh during the last three financial years. The bidder shall have at least 1 year of relevant IT services experience. The bidder shall submit PAN and GST Registration certificates. EMD is Rs. 50,000. Bids close on 20 December 2026 at 15:30 IST.
